expected_value_creation: Immutable policy lineage and deterministic historical replay make changed trust outcomes visible and governable without mutating prior evidence.
beneficiary: Portable QIF knowledge consumers, governance owners, and auditors
supporting_evidence: GitHub offline attestation guidance requires refreshed trusted roots and warns that stale roots miss revocation.
Sigstore TUF guidance supports root rotation, revocation timing, and freshness.
success_criteria: Original decisions remain immutable and resolve their original policy revision.
Replay under a named later policy reproduces unchanged, tightened, relaxed, or indeterminate outcomes and routes material change or missing inputs to governance.
